no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: All Damora assets (DMR-001 anti-mutCALR mAb for ET/MF; DMR-002, DMR-003) are preclinical / IND-enabling. Per FY2025 10-K filed 2026-03-19, Damora plans to file U.S. IND or ex-US CTA for DMR-001 in mid-2026 with first-in-human Phase 1 to follow. DMR-002 IND planned 2H 2026; DMR-003 in 2027. No active P1/P2/P3 trials at snapshot date 2026-05-06. (Damora is the rebranded entity formed from Galecto's November 2025 acquisition of private Damora; legacy Galecto galectin programs were discontinued.)

website.note: Pipeline page confirms DMR-001 is preclinical/IND-enabling; no NCT IDs disclosed.

excluded_preclinical.status: Preclinical; IND/CTA filing planned mid-2026; Phase 1 to follow
